payload.text: 0084 (low, cc's): seven tests of a missing tool's refusal skip wherever the tool is installed. Design approved (path_without, a farm of links, one ln per PATH directory, last to first; proof by mutation and a farm control; the farm made once per test under BATS_TEST_TMPDIR; the header says the per-directory glob stays inside ARG_MAX). Built on 0082's head once it lands, since 0082 changes test_helper.bash, cryptz.bats and macoz.bats; after 0085 (vc's order: 0081, 0085, 0084, 0087).
